'''Rod Latham Ralltiir Universal (Sept 1999)''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst13.htm Ralltiir Universal], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183217/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst13.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Naboo Regionals]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}

== Introduction ==
Trandosite lists this as one of [[Rod Latham]]'s tournament decks: played 12th September 1999, 2 wins and 1 losses from 3 games (differential -3).<ref name="trandosite" />
